<html lang="zh-Hant"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"><title>115 北北基第三次英文模擬考｜互動學習</title><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Zen+Maru+Gothic:wght@500;700;900&display=swap"><style>
:root{--ink:#3b2f5c;--pk:#ff8fb1;--pk2:#ffe0ea;--sky:#8fd3ff;--sky2:#e3f5ff;--lv:#b9a6ff;--mint:#b8f0d4;--sun:#ffe58a;--card:#fffdfb}
@media(prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root{--ink:#f3eaff;--pk2:#4a2a3d;--sky2:#1e3445;--card:#2b2347;--mint:#1f4a3a;--sun:#5a4a1a}body{background:linear-gradient(#1c1838,#2a1f4a)!important}}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
body{margin:0;color:var(--ink);font:16px/1.75 "Zen Maru Gothic","Noto Sans TC","PingFang TC","Microsoft JhengHei",sans-serif;background:linear-gradient(#cfeeff,#ffe6f1 60%,#f1e8ff);min-height:100vh}
header{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:5;padding:10px 14px;background:var(--card);border-bottom:4px solid var(--pk);border-radius:0 0 22px 22px;box-shadow:0 5px 0 var(--lv)}
.bar{max-width:760px;margin:auto;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
h1{font-size:18px;margin:0;flex:1}
.score{font-weight:900;background:var(--sun);border:3px solid var(--ink);border-radius:20px;padding:0 12px;white-space:nowrap}
.prog{max-width:760px;margin:8px auto 0;height:12px;border:3px solid var(--ink);border-radius:10px;background:var(--card);overflow:hidden}.prog i{display:block;height:100%;width:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--pk),var(--lv));transition:width .4s}
main{position:relative;z-index:1;max-width:760px;margin:auto;padding:14px}
h2{display:inline-block;font-size:16px;margin:26px 0 6px;padding:4px 16px;background:var(--pk);color:#fff;border:3px solid var(--ink);border-radius:20px;box-shadow:3px 3px 0 var(--ink)}
.note{font-size:14px;opacity:.8;margin:4px 0 8px}
.grp{background:var(--sky2);border:3px dashed var(--sky);border-radius:16px;padding:10px 14px;margin:12px 0;font-size:14px}
.q{background:var(--card);border:3px solid var(--ink);border-radius:22px;box-shadow:5px 5px 0 var(--lv);padding:16px;margin:16px 0}
.qh{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:6px}
.no{background:var(--pk);color:#fff;border:3px solid var(--ink);border-radius:50%;width:38px;height:38px;display:grid;place-items:center;font-weight:900}
.lv{font-size:12px;font-weight:700;border:2px solid var(--ink);border-radius:12px;padding:0 9px;background:var(--mint)}
.lv.h{background:var(--pk2)}
.q p{margin:0 0 12px;font-family:Georgia,"Noto Serif TC",serif;font-size:17px}
.opts{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px}
@media(max-width:520px){.opts{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.opt{padding:9px 14px;border:3px solid var(--ink);border-radius:16px;background:var(--sky2);cursor:pointer;font-weight:700;transition:transform .1s}
.opt:hover:not(.off){transform:translateY(-2px) rotate(-.5deg);background:var(--sun)}
.opt.off{cursor:default}
.opt.ok{background:var(--mint)}
.opt.bad{background:var(--pk2);text-decoration:line-through wavy var(--pk)}
:focus-visible{outline:4px solid var(--lv);outline-offset:2px}
.w{border-bottom:3px dotted var(--pk);cursor:help;font-weight:700}
.w:hover{background:var(--sun)}
.hbtn{margin-top:12px;font:inherit;font-weight:700;padding:3px 14px;border:3px solid var(--ink);border-radius:20px;background:var(--sun);color:var(--ink);cursor:pointer;box-shadow:2px 2px 0 var(--ink)}
.hint,.exp{display:none;position:relative;margin-top:14px;padding:10px 14px;border:3px solid var(--ink);border-radius:18px;font-size:15px}
.hint{background:var(--sun)}
.exp{background:var(--pk2);white-space:pre-line}
.hint:before,.exp:before{content:"";position:absolute;top:-11px;left:26px;width:16px;height:16px;background:inherit;border-left:3px solid var(--ink);border-top:3px solid var(--ink);transform:rotate(45deg)}
.show{display:block}
.voc{display:block;margin-top:8px;padding-top:6px;border-top:2px dashed var(--ink);font-size:14px}
#tip{display:none;position:fixed;z-index:50;max-width:290px;padding:10px 14px;background:var(--card);border:3px solid var(--ink);border-radius:16px;box-shadow:4px 4px 0 var(--pk);font-size:15px;line-height:1.6}
#tip .u{margin-top:6px;padding:4px 8px;background:var(--sun);border-radius:10px;font-size:14px}
.reset{margin:24px 0;font:inherit;font-weight:900;padding:8px 22px;border:3px solid var(--ink);border-radius:22px;background:var(--pk);color:#fff;box-shadow:3px 3px 0 var(--ink);cursor:pointer}
.say{border:2px solid var(--ink);border-radius:50%;background:var(--sun);cursor:pointer;width:28px;height:28px;padding:0;font-size:14px}#tip .ex{margin-top:6px;padding:6px 10px;border:2px dashed var(--lv);border-radius:10px;font-size:14px}#tip small{opacity:.8}#tip{max-width:330px}.pass{background:var(--card);border:3px solid var(--ink);border-radius:22px;box-shadow:5px 5px 0 var(--sky);padding:14px 18px;margin:12px 0;font-family:Georgia,"Noto Serif TC",serif;font-size:16px}.pass p{margin:0 0 10px;text-indent:1.5em}.blank{display:inline-block;min-width:3.2em;text-align:center;font:700 14px sans-serif;background:var(--sun);border:2px solid var(--ink);border-radius:10px;padding:0 8px}.blank.fill{background:var(--mint);font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:15px}.tr{background:var(--card);border:3px solid var(--ink);border-radius:22px;box-shadow:5px 5px 0 var(--lv);padding:16px;margin:16px 0}.tr input{font:inherit;width:8.5em;border:0;border-bottom:3px solid var(--pk);background:var(--sun);color:var(--ink);border-radius:8px 8px 0 0;padding:0 6px;text-align:center}.tr input.ok{background:var(--mint)}.tr input.bad{background:var(--pk2)}.tr .en{font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:17px;line-height:2.2}.no{min-width:38px;width:auto;padding:0 9px;border-radius:19px}.tr input{width:10em}.map{max-width:100%;display:block;margin:10px auto;border:3px solid var(--ink);border-radius:12px;background:#fff}.sx{display:none;margin-top:14px;padding:12px 16px;border:3px solid var(--ink);border-radius:18px;background:var(--card);font-size:15px;line-height:1.7}
.sx h4{margin:0 0 2px;font-size:18px}.sx h5{margin:14px 0 4px;font-size:16px;border-top:2px solid var(--ink);padding-top:10px}.sx .si{margin:0 0 8px;opacity:.85}
.sent{font:19px/2.6 Georgia,serif}.seg{display:inline-block;border:2.5px solid var(--c);border-radius:10px;padding:0 8px;margin:2px;line-height:1.6;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--c) 13%,transparent)}
.sk{margin:8px 0 12px}.sk .seg{font-size:14px;padding:0 6px}
.rl{display:flex;gap:12px;margin:8px 0}.rl i{flex:none;width:26px;height:26px;margin-top:3px;border:2.5px solid var(--c);border-radius:8px;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--c) 13%,transparent)}
.ck{display:flex;gap:10px;margin:4px 0}.ck b{flex:none;width:1.4em}.ck u{text-decoration:none;flex:none;min-width:8.5em;font-weight:700}
.sx.show{display:block}</style></head><body><header><div class="bar"><h1>🐱 115 北北基第三次英文模擬考｜互動學習</h1><span class="score" id="sc">⭐ 0 / 0</span></div><div class="prog"><i id="pg"></i></div></header><main id="app"></main><div id="tip"></div><script>const S=[
{title:"一、詞彙題（Q1–10）",note:"單選，每題 1 分。先試著作答；卡住時可點「💡 提示」。",qs:[
{n:1,t:"Pearl checked the mailbox every day after placing an order online, and when the ___ finally arrived, she tore it open excitedly.",o:["cargo","bundle","parcel","luggage"],a:2,h:"網購下單後，送到信箱的東西是什麼？想「包裹」。",e:"parcel＝包裹。\n(A) cargo 船運、空運的大宗貨物，不會寄到信箱 (B) bundle 一捆 (D) luggage 行李",v:"parcel 包裹｜cargo 貨物"},
{n:2,t:"Chloe looks surprisingly ___ in that black dress. Is it the color, or has she actually lost some weight?",o:["superior","eloquent","expressive","slender"],a:3,h:"後句提到「是不是瘦了」，找描述身形的形容詞。",e:"slender＝苗條的，與 lost weight 呼應。\n(A) 優越的 (B) 口才好的 (C) 富表情的",v:"slender 苗條的"},
{n:3,t:"Doctors warn that the painkiller contains a highly addictive ___ that could leave patients dependent on it within weeks.",o:["composition","substance","resource","presence"],a:1,h:"藥裡含有的「成癮『物質』」。",e:"substance＝物質。\n(A) composition 組成方式或整體結構，非某一具體物質 (C) 資源 (D) 存在",v:"addictive 使人上癮的｜substance 物質"},
{n:4,t:"If you prefer a milder flavor, you can ___ the chili powder from the recipe when you make the Thai curry.",o:["withdraw","dismiss","neglect","omit"],a:3,h:"想要比較溫和，所以食譜裡的辣椒粉要「省略」。",e:"omit＝省略、刪去。\n(C) neglect 強調本來應做而疏忽，但此處是刻意不加辣椒粉，故不可用。(A) 撤回 (B) 解散",v:"omit 省略｜neglect 疏忽"},
{n:5,t:"Don't put those clothes into the closet while they are still ___. Otherwise, they may start to smell.",o:["damp","stale","coarse","rusty"],a:0,h:"衣服還沒乾、會發出臭味，是什麼狀態？",e:"damp＝潮濕的。\n(B) stale 食物不新鮮、空氣不流通 (C) 粗糙的 (D) 生鏽的",v:"damp 潮濕的"},
{n:6,t:"The English final exam contains 100 multiple-choice questions; it's ___ impossible to finish them all in just one hour!",o:["urgently","practically","intensively","roughly"],a:1,h:"「幾乎」不可能。",e:"practically＝幾乎。\n(A) 緊急地 (C) 密集地 (D) 大約",v:"practically 幾乎"},
{n:7,t:"I can't explain how I knew. I just had an ___ that Lily would cancel the date before she even called me.",o:["association","explanation","observation","intuition"],a:3,h:"「說不出怎麼知道」＝一種「直覺」。",e:"intuition＝直覺。\n(A) 聯想 (B) 解釋 (C) 觀察",v:"intuition 直覺"},
{n:8,t:"It's hard to find a physical bookstore now, as so many have been forced to ___ operations due to competition from online sellers.",o:["mend","resume","cease","vary"],a:2,h:"實體書店難找，是因為被迫「停止」營業。",e:"cease operations＝停止營業。\n(A) 修補 (B) 恢復 (D) 變化",v:"cease 停止"},
{n:9,t:"It was such an ___ day for a picnic, with soft sunshine, a gentle breeze, and clear, cloudless skies.",o:["available","agreeable","eligible","evident"],a:1,h:"陽光柔和、微風輕拂：適合野餐的「宜人」日子。",e:"agreeable＝宜人的、令人愉快的。\n(A) 可利用的 (C) 有資格的，用於人或事物是否符合條件 (D) 明顯的，不能形容天氣的特質",v:"agreeable 宜人的"},
{n:10,t:"The dishonest police officer ___ an innocent man for the robbery by secretly placing stolen jewelry in his apartment.",o:["framed","provoked","suspected","pursued"],a:0,h:"偷偷把贓物放進別人家，目的是「栽贓」。",e:"frame someone＝栽贓、誣陷。\n(B) 激怒 (C) 懷疑 (D) 追捕",v:"frame 栽贓"}
]},
{title:"二、綜合測驗（Q11–20）",note:"題組只節錄含空格的關鍵句，完整短文請對照試卷。",qs:[
{n:11,t:"",o:["a shocking revelation","a popular myth","a curious coincidence","an unexpected encounter"],a:2,h:"剛學到某件事就覺得到處都看到，最直覺的說法是「好巧」。",e:"a curious coincidence＝奇特的巧合。\n(A) 未提到有什麼被揭露 (B) 前句描述的不是大家相信的錯誤信念 (D) 並非一次興奮的相遇",v:"coincidence 巧合"},
{n:12,t:"",o:["stuck","retained","reserved","forwarded"],a:0,h:"主詞是 the unusual label，要表達「被沿用、流行開來」，動詞不能接受詞。",e:"stick＝黏住、留存、流行開來，為不及物動詞。\n(B)(C)(D) retained / reserved / forwarded 皆為及物動詞，後面須接受詞。",v:"stick 留存、流傳"},
{n:13,t:"",o:["single out","tune out","pitch in","give in"],a:1,h:"focus on 新事物，同時對其他事物要「視而不見」。",e:"tune out＝不理睬、對…置之不理，與 focus on 語意相對。\n(A) 挑出 (C) 合力幫忙 (D) 讓步",v:"tune out 屏蔽、充耳不聞"},
{n:14,t:"",o:["subsequent","automatic","dynamic","fundamental"],a:0,h:"預期會更常看到，然後「接下來」每一次的目擊都在強化信念。",e:"subsequent＝後續的，修飾 sighting，呼應前句的「預期」。\n(B) 自動的 (C) 動態的 (D) 基本的",v:"subsequent 後續的"},
{n:15,t:"",o:["it's never too late","there's a need","it's worth a try","there's no way"],a:3,h:"這是大腦運作方式的一部分，所以關掉它是…？",e:"there's no way to V＝不可能做到，語意與 as it is a part of how the brain operates 最連貫。\n(A) 永遠不嫌晚 (B) 有此需要 (C) 值得一試",v:"mechanism 機制"},
{n:16,t:"",o:["at a loss","on edge","on the spot","at risk"],a:1,h:"後半 never lets them relax，找與「放鬆」相對的片語。",e:"on edge＝緊張不安、坐立難安。\n(A) 不知所措 (C) 當場為難 (D) 處於危險中",v:"on edge 緊張不安"},
{n:17,t:"",o:["are most likely to form","have hardly become","have yet to develop","have ever achieved"],a:3,h:"語意是「很少有影集曾達到這種文化狂熱」。注意 few 本身已帶否定意味。",e:"few shows have ever achieved＝很少影集曾達到。\n(B) few + hardly 雙重否定 (C) have yet to develop＝尚未，與 few 連用語意變成「大部分已經培養出」，與原意相反。",v:"obsession 狂熱"},
{n:18,t:"",o:["to play","playing","play","played"],a:2,h:"找這句真正的主要動詞。主詞是複數名詞，且全文用現在簡單式。",e:"主詞是 Masterful '80s nostalgia ... loyalty，複數，且文章用現在簡單式描述劇集特色，故用 play。\n(A) 不定詞不能當主要動詞 (B) 分詞不能單獨當主要動詞 (D) 過去式時態不一致。",v:"play their part 發揮作用"},
{n:19,t:"",o:["references","promotion","contributions","expansion"],a:0,h:"後面接 to 加上「觀眾會立刻認出的電影與小說」，想「致敬、引用」。",e:"make references to＝提及、引用，來向這些作品致敬。\n(B)(C)(D) 皆無法與「經典作品」搭配。",v:"reference 引用、指涉"},
{n:20,t:"",o:["in due time","against all odds","above all else","for the time being"],a:2,h:"插入語，要在許多因素中突出「情感投入」最重要。",e:"above all else＝最重要的是、尤其。作者前面列了多種成功要素，結尾強調情感投入最關鍵。\n(A) 到了適當的時候 (B) 儘管困難重重 (D) 暫時、目前",v:"above all else 最重要的是"}
]}
];

const G={"hype":"大肆炒作、熱烈宣傳||spark hype 引發話題；hype up 大肆宣傳||The movie sparked great hype online.／這部電影在網路上引發熱議。",
"feat":"壯舉、功績||a technological feat 技術壯舉||Climbing Everest is a great feat.／攀登聖母峰是一大壯舉。",
"extinct":"絕種的、已滅絕的||n. extinction；go extinct 絕種||Dinosaurs are extinct.／恐龍已經絕種。",
"fossilized":"成為化石的||n. fossil 化石",
"extracted":"→extract",
"extract":"提取、萃取||extract A from B||They extracted oil from olives.／他們從橄欖中榨油。",
"isolated":"→isolate",
"isolate":"分離出；使孤立||isolate A from B；adj. isolated 孤立的；n. isolation||Scientists isolated the virus.／科學家分離出這種病毒。",
"implanted":"→implant",
"implant":"植入||implant A into B||The embryo was implanted into the mother.／胚胎被植入母體。",
"exhibit":"展現（特徵）；展出||exhibit signs / traits；n. exhibition 展覽||The patient exhibits mild symptoms.／病人呈現輕微症狀。",
"marvel":"驚嘆||marvel at ...||We marveled at the view.／我們對景色讚嘆不已。",
"marvels":"→marvel",
"snowballing":"（像滾雪球般）迅速擴大||v. snowball||Debt is snowballing.／債務越滾越大。",
"broadcast":"傳播、廣播||broadcast–broadcast–broadcast||The news was broadcast worldwide.／消息向全世界播送。",
"cited":"→cite",
"cite":"引用；援引為例||cite A as B||He cited the study as proof.／他引用這項研究作為證據。",
"reversible":"可逆的||反義 irreversible 不可逆的",
"play god":"自以為是上帝、干預自然",
"northwest passage":"西北航道（經北極海連結大西洋與太平洋）",
"strong grip on":"牢牢掌控||have a grip on ...||The company has a firm grip on the market.／這公司牢牢掌控市場。",
"set off":"出發；引爆||set off for + 地點||We set off for Hualien at dawn.／我們破曉出發前往花蓮。",
"turn back":"折返、往回走||turn back halfway 半途折返||The storm forced us to turn back.／暴風雨逼我們折返。",
"ill health":"健康不佳||＝poor health",
"engage in":"參與、從事||engage in sports||He engaged in a long debate.／他投入一場長時間的辯論。",
"state affairs":"國事、政務",
"throne":"王位、寶座||on the throne 在位",
"reluctant":"不情願的||be reluctant to V||She was reluctant to leave.／她不太願意離開。",
"overthrown":"→overthrow",
"overthrow":"推翻（政權）||overthrow–overthrew–overthrown||The king was overthrown.／國王被推翻了。",
"puzzled":"感到困惑的||v. puzzle 使困惑||I was puzzled by his answer.／他的答案讓我困惑。",
"intended":"打算的、預定的||an intended recipient 預定的收件人",
"recipient":"接收者、收件人",
"forge":"建立、鍛造（關係、同盟）||forge a partnership / bond||The two firms forged a strong alliance.／兩家公司建立起緊密的聯盟。",
"dusk":"黃昏||反義 dawn 黎明||Bats come out at dusk.／蝙蝠在黃昏出沒。",
"dawn":"黎明、破曉",
"blossoms":"（樹的）花、花朵||v. blossom 開花",
"unfold":"展開、綻開||The flower unfolds at night.／這花在夜間綻開。",
"nocturnal":"夜間活動的||反義 diurnal；Owls are nocturnal.／貓頭鷹在夜間活動。",
"emit":"散發、發出（光、氣味）||emit a smell / sound||The factory emits smoke.／工廠排放煙霧。",
"sulfur":"硫磺",
"stalks":"（花、葉的）梗、莖||a stalk of celery 一根芹菜",
"sturdier":"→sturdy",
"sturdy":"堅固的、結實的||a sturdy chair",
"compact":"小巧緊湊的||a compact car 小型車",
"irresistible":"無法抗拒的||v. resist 抵抗||The cake was irresistible.／那蛋糕讓人無法抗拒。",
"vanish":"消失||vanish into thin air 憑空消失||The bats vanished at dawn.／蝙蝠在黎明消失了。",
"fragrance":"香氣、芬芳||adj. fragrant",
"reproduction":"繁殖；複製品||v. reproduce",
"habitat":"棲地||habitat loss 棲地喪失",
"heritage":"遺產、傳承||cultural heritage 文化遺產||We must protect our cultural heritage.／我們必須保護文化遺產。",
"iconic":"象徵性的、標誌性的||n. icon",
"enduring":"持久的||v. endure 忍耐；持續||an enduring friendship／長久的友誼",
"legacy":"遺產、傳承||leave a legacy 留下遺產||He left a legacy of kindness.／他留下善良的遺產。",
"instinct":"本能、直覺||by instinct 憑本能||Birds migrate by instinct.／鳥類憑本能遷徙。",
"prospered":"→prosper",
"prosper":"繁榮、興旺||adj. prosperous；n. prosperity||The town prospered after the railway came.／鐵路通車後小鎮繁榮起來。",
"prosperity":"繁榮、興盛",

11:`Have you ever heard a new song or learned a new word, and suddenly it seems that you're hearing or seeing it everywhere? You might be tempted to call it [[11]], or even interpret it as some sign from the universe, but there's actually a term for this occurrence: the Baader-Meinhof phenomenon.

The name can be traced back to 1994, when someone noticed the German far-left group "Baader-Meinhof" mentioned twice within a single day shortly after first hearing of it. He wrote in to a newspaper, many others related, and the unusual label [[12]]. Now, the Baader-Meinhof phenomenon has a more clinical term: frequency illusion.

Two cognitive processes are at work in creating the illusion. The first is selective attention: the brain's tendency to focus on something newly learned and [[13]] everything else. Once it enters our awareness, the brain prioritizes it even though it has always been there. Confirmation bias then strengthens this effect. As we expect to see the new thing more often, each [[14]] sighting confirms our belief that the world is suddenly filled with what has caught our eye.

The Baader-Meinhof phenomenon may grow troubling if left unchecked. For instance, a newly diagnosed patient may over-report symptoms they have always had. To be frank, [[15]] to turn off this mechanism, as it is a part of how the brain operates. But understanding this can remind us that our perception is rarely objective. Next time the world seems to echo back what you've just learned, pause: the frequency hasn't changed. Your attention has.`,
16:`Flickering lights, a missing child, a strange girl with psychic powers, and a terrifying monster that shouldn't exist. From its very first episode, Stranger Things puts viewers [[16]], and never quite lets them relax again. Since its debut on Netflix in July 2016, the show has grown into one of the most talked-about television series in recent memory, inspiring fan theories, themed merchandise, and a cultural obsession that few shows [[17]].

So what explains its extraordinary appeal? The ingredients are many. Masterful '80s nostalgia, a loveable cast, genuinely terrifying monsters, and a beating heart of friendship and loyalty, skillfully woven into every episode, all [[18]] their part. Stranger Things is set in a world that feels instantly familiar and deeply relatable. Hawkins, the town where all the stories take place, looks like every small American town. The electronic soundtrack, the warm visuals, and the deliberate [[19]] to some beloved films and novels that audiences would immediately recognize, like E.T., The Goonies, and the works of Stephen King, work together to evoke a fond childhood memory for viewers young and old.

At its core, Stranger Things is a story about what it means to grow up. The characters' bonds and stubborn loyalties tap into something universal. When watching the characters fight against evil, audiences root for them as if rooting for old friends. That emotional investment built across multiple seasons is, [[20]], what transformed a clever Netflix original into a once-in-a-generation phenomenon.`,
21:`Have you ever had butterflies in your stomach or a sudden urge to go to the bathroom when nervous? If so, you've experienced the gut-brain connection [[21]]. For decades, scientists assumed the gut simply followed the brain's [[22]]. But research now suggests that the trillions of microbes in the digestive tract exert considerable control over the brain as well.

These microbes, collectively known as the gut microbiome, do far more than simply help digest food to provide [[23]]. Through multiple channels, they constantly interact with the brain. Most directly, they [[24]] signals with the brain via the vagus nerve, a physical link between the brain and the gut. These microbes also influence the production of neurotransmitters like serotonin and GABA, both of which assist in the regulation of mood, stress, and memory. Additionally, the microbiome works with the immune system to keep inflammation [[25]], preventing it from interfering with normal brain function. A balanced microbiome supports healthy brain function; however, when this delicate balance is disrupted, cognitive and emotional problems may [[26]].

Animal research has shown that mice raised without any gut bacteria tend to be more anxious, less sociable, and more hyperactive, with a reduced ability to learn or remember. Yet after specific probiotics are introduced, they show improved social and cognitive function. Human studies also suggest probiotics' potential for boosting memory and stabilizing mood, but they remain limited in scale and require further [[27]]. In contrast, long-term antibiotic use, which can wipe out beneficial bacteria originally [[28]] in the gut, has been linked to poorer cognitive performance and mental health issues.

To [[29]] our cognitive and emotional well-being, we can nurture the gut microbiome through simple daily habits. Consuming fiber-rich and fermented foods, getting adequate sleep, and engaging in regular exercise all help create a(n) [[30]] environment for beneficial gut bacteria. By taking good care of the gut microbiome, we are investing in both our mental and cognitive health.`,
31:`Walk into any Gen Zer's bedroom today and you might find shelves lined with collectibles — plushies like Labubu and Jellycat. Clearly, plush toys are no longer just for kids. This trend reflects something deeper about the generation driving it.

On the surface, this phenomenon is fueled by nostalgia. Plush toys offer a rare source of uncomplicated happiness in an overwhelming world. Psychologists interpret this as a form of the "Peter Pan effect," where young adults cling to childhood artifacts to escape the responsibilities of maturity. [[31]]

The economic realities facing Gen Z shed further light on this trend. Many feel they cannot afford the kind of adult life they had once imagined. Economic turmoil and skyrocketing costs of living have put immense pressure on them, while footage of war on social media deepens their sense of uncertainty and instability. [[32]] Rather than saving for goals that now feel unattainable, they redirect their income toward small, manageable sources of happiness.

[[33]] For many, buying and collecting plush toys offers unexpected relief from it. By joining online collector communities and attending immersive pop-up events, they transform solitary objects into shared social currency and gain a sense of belonging that modern life often fails to provide.

The popularity of plushies among Gen Z is not a sign of immaturity. [[34]] Faced with uncertainty and pressure, they are finding new ways to experience joy and connection. While these choices may seem childish at times, they reveal a deliberate effort to build meaning in an increasingly unpredictable world.`};

35:`Their names are Romulus, Remus and Khaleesi, and they're the first dire wolves to walk the Earth in over 10,000 years — or at least that's what one biotech company would like you to believe.

In 2024, Colossal Biosciences announced the births of three dire wolves, extinct since the last ice age. While the young wolves have sparked great hype on social media, what Colossal did is not genuine de-extinction, but a case of conservation-washing. Its scientists extracted dire wolf DNA from ancient fossilized remains. After careful analysis, they isolated a handful of genes by identifying key genetic markers. They then edited those into the genomes of modern grey wolves. The modified cells were used to create embryos, which were implanted into surrogate dogs. The pups exhibit some traits of dire wolves: broader shoulders, larger bodies and pale coats. Impressive as this technological feat is, these pups are, at best, hybrids. Colossal's claim that it has brought back a once-eradicated species for the first time in human history is misleading. It's simply a ploy of clever marketing and emotional appeal.

Before the dire wolf project, Colossal used a similar technique to engineer a "wooly mouse" — a rodent genetically modified to have mammoth-like pelts. As the leading company in the growing de-extinction movement in the US, it promises that its technologies will help restore ecological balance and bring back other extinct creatures. Meanwhile, in Europe, a group of startups is applying technology in more grounded, practical ways. For instance, Stream Ocean from Switzerland has developed facial recognition software to monitor fish species, and Germany's Soilytix tracks soil health using environmental DNA. This is where technology can genuinely support biodiversity restoration — not through Frankensteinian genetic manipulations.

Colossal has broadcast the message that extinction is reversible, but it's not. This may create a dangerous distraction from proven solutions to the biodiversity crisis. The Trump administration has already cited Colossal's claims as an excuse to reduce endangered species protections. While the public marvels at the adorable "dire-ish" wolves, biodiversity loss is snowballing. Instead of playing God with long-extinct creatures, humanity's true priority should be to safeguard existing biodiversity and restore what's been damaged.`,
39:`In 1602, Queen Elizabeth I of England wrote a letter to the Emperor of China in the hope of opening up a trade route and starting friendly relations. She entrusted the letter to George Weymouth, who had been hired by the East India Company to seek a northwest passage to the Far East. This was part of England's broader effort to find an alternative trade route to the east, where the Portuguese and Dutch held a strong grip on trade. Weymouth carried the letter in English, accompanied by copies in Latin, Spanish and Italian.

However, the letter did not arrive as planned. Weymouth, with 35 men aboard, set off from Ratcliffe on 2nd May 1602. The westward crossing of the Atlantic was uneventful, but the waters beyond proved far more challenging. Heavy fog and sheets of ice near southern Greenland blocked their path, but Weymouth pushed further into the narrow channel between Baffin Island and the Ungava Peninsula, convinced that it might open westward into the Pacific. He led the expedition deeper into the channel, but had to turn back before reaching its far end. Ultimately, it was ill health that brought the exploration to a halt. On 26th July, with his crew increasingly unwell from the deprivations of the journey, Weymouth called off the voyage and headed for home, arriving back in Dartmouth on 5th September.

Interestingly, had Weymouth made landfall in China, he might not have been able to deliver the letter to Emperor Wanli. From around 1582, Emperor Wanli had grown estranged from his role. Somehow he felt he no longer belonged on the throne, becoming reluctant to engage in state affairs. The resulting internal power struggles weakened the Empire, which was eventually overthrown by the Manchu people from the north in 1644.

The letter itself, however, managed to survive. It was later found lining a bran bin on a Lancashire farm. How the letter ended up there has puzzled many. It eventually became the property of the Crosse family, who later passed it to the Lancashire County Record Office. Then in 1984, a copy was finally delivered to China, completing the voyage Her Majesty had intended nearly four centuries earlier.`,
43:`In Disney's The Lion King, the wise mandrill Rafiki makes his home in a massive, ancient tree. In reality, this is the baobab, an African icon often called the "Tree of Life," for it supports entire ecosystems with its thick, water-storing trunk. Yet, the survival of the baobab itself depends on the partnerships its flowers forge with creatures of the night: bats and moths.

Across Africa, the baobab blooms only once a year, and its blossoms open at dusk and fade by dawn. Each night, just a few unfold while the rest wait for their turn. The white blossoms all hang down from the branches like lanterns, guiding their nocturnal pollinators to visit.

To attract specific visitors, baobabs in different regions have developed distinct flowers. In West Africa, the flowers emit a sulfur-like scent to draw the key pollinator: the large straw-colored fruit bat. The flowers here are big, with petals folding back, long stalks, and deep pools of nectar, perfectly suited for the bat to feed while hanging upside down. In East Africa, the baobab blossoms are sturdier and more compact, with shorter stalks and less nectar. They have the same irresistible smell that caters to the smaller Egyptian fruit bat, which feeds by grasping the flowers rather than hanging upside down. Further south, the bats vanish entirely and moths take over. A sweet fragrance replaces sulfur to appeal to moths, while the flowers shrink, petals curve back only slightly, and nectar reduces to mere drops.

Clearly, each baobab has locked its future to a single group of partners. Yet these alliances are surprisingly fragile. After all, it takes thousands of years for the baobab to shape its floral traits. Since birds, bees, and beetles do not pollinate baobab flowers, if climate change or habitat loss causes these bats and moths to disappear, the baobab's reproduction would halt entirely. With no new trees growing, the survival of the species would be threatened. Therefore, protecting the baobab isn't just about saving the "Tree of Life"; it's about safeguarding the silent winged creatures of the night — the true Rafikis of the "Circle of Life."`};

{n:42,t:"Which of the following statements is true, according to the passage?",o:["The Crosse family eventually revealed how the letter ended up on a Lancashire farm.","Arriving in China was no guarantee that the letter would reach its intended recipient.","The Queen wrote the letter, hoping to be the first to establish trade relations with China.","Nearly 400 years after the expedition, the Queen's original letter finally made it to China."],a:1,h:"看第三段開頭：即使登陸中國，也未必能把信交給皇帝。",e:"選 (B)。第三段 he might not have been able to deliver the letter to Emperor Wanli。(A) 文中說 puzzled many，並未揭曉；(C) 文中沒有「第一個」的意思；(D) 1984 年送達的是 a copy，並非原信。"},

Look closer and discover how the Moai “walked.”"],["D. Between Two Worlds","What connects the world of the living and the dead? Today, the Rapa Nui, guided by their mana, continue to reclaim their language, traditions, and identity."]];

{n:"47–48",zh:"摘要填空：從展覽介紹中找出兩個單詞，並依句型變化字形（每格一字，各 2 分）。",tpl:"The exhibition Rapa Nui: Echoes of the Moai highlights how the resilient Rapa Nui, despite living in {1} from the rest of the world, left behind a remarkable legacy. Their monumental Moai, ancestral artifacts, and sacred rituals reflect a once-{2} civilization that reached its peak before the 19th-century crises.",ans:[["isolation"],["prosperous"]],h:"47：in 後接名詞，由前言的 isolated 轉成名詞。48：once- 後接形容詞，由 A、B 展廳的 prosper / prosperity 轉成形容詞。",full:"47. isolation　48. prosperous"},

12:{t:"第 12 題：三個並列子句，label 後面缺動詞",i:"逗號連接三個「主詞＋動詞」；第三個子句 the unusual label 後面還沒有動詞，空格要補不及物動詞。",

 c:[[1,"(A) stuck","不及物，後面不需受詞"],[0,"(B) retained","及物動詞，後面必須有受詞"],[0,"(C) reserved","及物動詞，後面必須有受詞"],[0,"(D) forwarded","及物動詞，後面必須有受詞（forward an email）"]]},
17:{t:"第 17 題：few 本身已帶否定意味",i:"that 是關係代名詞，代替 achieved 的受詞；子句裡的主詞是 few shows，缺的是動詞。",
 s:[["a cultural obsession","b"],["that","k"],["few shows","o"],["have ever achieved","r"],["."]],
 k:[["先行詞","b"],["關代 that","k"],["主詞 few shows","o"],["動詞","r"]],

 c:[[0,"(A) are most likely to form","most likely（最有可能）與 few（很少）語意矛盾"],[0,"(B) have hardly become","few + hardly 是雙重否定；become 後也缺補語"],[0,"(C) have yet to develop","few 加上「尚未」會變成「大部分已培養出」，語意相反"],[1,"(D) have ever achieved","很少影集曾達到這種文化狂熱，符合文意"]]},

 s:[["( Masterful '80s nostalgia )","b"],[","],["( a loveable cast )","b"],[","],["( genuinely terrifying monsters )","b"],[", and"],["( a beating heart of friendship and loyalty )","b"],[","],["( skillfully woven into every episode )","g"],[","],["all","o"],["__18__ = play","r"],["their part.","k"]],
 k:[["( 名詞組 )×4","b"],["( 分詞片語 )","g"],["同位語 all","o"],["動詞","r"],["受詞","k"]],
 r:[["b","主詞：四個並列的名詞組","四個名詞組並列，合起來是複數主詞"],["g","過去分詞片語","skillfully woven... ＝ which are skillfully woven...，修飾前面的主詞；分詞片語不是動詞，拿掉句子不受影響"],["o","同位語 all","all 把前面四項總括起來（＝all of them），同位語也不是動詞"],["r","主要動詞（空格）","全句到這裡才第一次需要動詞：主詞是複數、現在式，所以填 play"],["k","受詞","their part；play their part（發揮各自的作用）是慣用說法"]],
 c:[[0,"(A) to play","不定詞不能當主要動詞"],[0,"(B) playing","現在分詞又變成另一個修飾語，句子還是沒有動詞"],[1,"(C) play","原形動詞，配合複數主詞 all，現在式"],[0,"(D) played","過去式與前後文現在式不一致"]]},

 k:[["主詞","b"],["( 分詞片語 )","g"],["動詞","r"],["插入語","o"],["補語","k"]],
 r:[["b","主詞","That emotional investment（情感投入）"],["g","過去分詞片語","built across multiple seasons＝which was built...，修飾 investment"],["r","動詞 is","連綴動詞，後接補語"],["o","插入語（空格）","夾在 is 與 what 之間，對整個結論加以強調，不影響句構"],["k","補語：what 引導的名詞子句","what ＝ the thing that；transform A into B 把 A 變成 B"]],
 c:[[0,"(A) in due time","時機成熟時自然發生，與「成功原因」無關"],[0,"(B) against all odds","儘管困難重重；此處沒有克服困難的語意"],[1,"(C) above all else","最重要的是；在眾多因素中突顯「情感投入」最關鍵"],[0,"(D) for the time being","暫時、目前；與全文所述的歷史定位不合"]]},
25:{t:"第 25 題：keep + 受詞 + 補語（空格是補語）",i:"to keep ... 是表目的的不定詞片語；其後 preventing ... 是分詞構句，說明保持什麼狀態的目的與結果。",
 s:[["the microbiome","b"],["works with the immune system","r"],["to keep inflammation ___ (in check)","o"],[","],["preventing it from interfering with normal brain function","g"],["."]],
 k:[["主詞","b"],["動詞","r"],["不定詞（目的）","o"],["分詞構句","g"]],
 r:[["b","主詞","the microbiome（微生物群）"],["r","動詞","works with the immune system（與免疫系統合作）"],["o","to keep + O + 補語","keep inflammation in check＝使發炎受到控制；空格要填「讓…保持某種狀態」的片語"],["g","分詞構句 preventing...","prevent A from V-ing＝使 A 無法…；說明「受控」帶來的效果"]]},

 s:[["long-term antibiotic use","b"],[", which can wipe out beneficial bacteria originally ___ in the gut","o"],["has been linked to","r"],["poorer cognitive performance and mental health issues","k"],["."]],
 k:[["主詞","b"],["非限定關係子句","o"],["動詞","r"],["受詞（to 的受詞）","k"]],
 r:[["b","主詞","long-term antibiotic use（長期使用抗生素）"],["o","非限定關係子句","which 補充說明主詞；內部 bacteria originally present in the gut ＝ bacteria which are originally present in the gut"],["r","動詞","has been linked to（現在完成被動），be linked to＝與…有關聯"],["k","受詞","poorer cognitive performance and mental health issues"]]},
35:{t:"文章難句（第二段）：Impressive as ... is",i:"「形容詞 + as + S + V」是讓步倒裝，等於 Although + S + V + 形容詞。",
 s:[["Impressive as this technological feat is","o"],[","],["these pups","b"],["are","r"],[", at best,","p"],["hybrids","k"],["."]],
 k:[["讓步子句","o"],["主詞","b"],["動詞","r"],["插入語","p"],["補語","k"]],
 r:[["o","讓步子句","＝Although this technological feat is impressive；形容詞提前到 as 前面"],["b","主詞","these pups（這些幼崽）"],["r","動詞 are","連綴動詞"],["p","插入語 at best","至多、充其量；語氣上降低評價"],["k","補語 hybrids","混種；全句說：技術再亮眼，充其量也只是混種"]]},
42:{t:"文章難句（第三段）：had Weymouth made landfall",i:"省略 if 的倒裝：If Weymouth had made landfall ... → Had Weymouth made landfall ...，是與過去事實相反的假設。",
 s:[["Interestingly,"],["had Weymouth made landfall in China","o"],[","],["he","b"],["might not have been able to deliver","r"],["the letter","k"],["to Emperor Wanli","p"],["."]],
 k:[["條件句（倒裝）","o"],["主詞","b"],["動詞","r"],["直接受詞","k"],["介系詞片語","p"]],
 r:[["o","條件句：Had + S + p.p.","＝If Weymouth had made landfall...；事實上他沒有抵達中國"],["r","主要子句：might not have p.p.","對過去的推測：可能就無法…；be able to V 的完成形"],["k","受詞","the letter（那封信）；deliver A to B"],["p","to Emperor Wanli","因此選 (B)：即使抵達中國，也不保證信能送到收件人手上"]]},

 s:[["Since birds, bees, and beetles do not pollinate baobab flowers","g"],[","],["if climate change or habitat loss causes these bats and moths to disappear","o"],[","],["the baobab's reproduction","b"],["would halt","r"],["entirely","k"],["."]],
 k:[["原因子句","g"],["條件子句","o"],["主詞","b"],["動詞","r"],["副詞","k"]],
 r:[["g","原因副詞子句：Since...","既然鳥、蜜蜂和甲蟲都不替猴麵包樹授粉"],["o","條件副詞子句：if...","cause A to V＝導致 A…；假設蝙蝠與飛蛾消失"],["b","主詞","the baobab's reproduction（繁殖）"],["r","動詞 would halt","if + 現在式，主句用 would：委婉、較不確定的推論"],["k","副詞 entirely","完全停擺；對應 Q44：南部品種移到西非會無法繁殖"]]}
};
function sx(n){const d=ST[n],C=c=>'style="--c:'+CC[c]+'"';
 return "<h4>"+d.t+'</h4><p class="si">'+d.i+'</p><div class="sent">'+d.s.map(([x,c])=>c?'<span class="seg" '+C(c)+">"+x+"</span>":x).join(" ")+'</div><div class="sk"><b>句子骨架：</b> '+d.k.map(([x,c])=>'<span class="seg" '+C(c)+">"+x+"</span>").join(" ")+"</div>"+
 d.r.map(([c,a,b])=>'<div class="rl"><i '+C(c)+'></i><div><b>'+a+"</b><br>"+b+"</div></div>").join("")+
 (d.c?"<h5>逐一檢查選項</h5>"+d.c.map(([o,a,b])=>'<div class="ck"><b style="color:'+(o?"#1b8a4b":"#d03a3a")+'">'+(o?"✓":"✗")+"</b><u>"+a+"</u><span>"+b+"</span></div>").join(""):"")}
const app=document.getElementById("app"),tip=document.getElementById("tip");let done=0,right=0,total=0;
S.forEach(s=>{
 app.insertAdjacentHTML("beforeend",`<h2>${s.title}</h2><div class="note">${s.note}　👆 點虛線底的單字可看意思與用法；點選項空白處作答。</div>`);
 s.qs.forEach(q=>{total++;
  if(GRP[q.n])app.insertAdjacentHTML("beforeend",`<div class="grp">${GRP[q.n]}</div>`);
  if(PS[q.n])app.insertAdjacentHTML("beforeend",'<div class="pass">'+gl(PS[q.n]).split("\n\n").map(p=>"<p>"+p.replace(/\[\[(\d+)\]\]/g,'<span class="blank" id="b$1">$1</span>')+"</p>").join("")+"</div>");
  const d=document.createElement("section");d.className="q";
  const lv=D[q.n]||"";
  d.innerHTML=`<div class="qh"><span class="no">${q.n}</span><span class="lv ${/難/.test(lv)?"h":""}">難易度：${lv}</span></div><p>${gl(q.t||"第 "+q.n+" 題：___").replace(/___/g,"<u>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</u>")}</p>${q.img?`<img class="map" src="${q.img}" alt="地圖">`:""}<div class="opts"></div><button class="hbtn" aria-expanded="false">💡 提示</button>${ST[q.n]?'<button class="hbtn sbtn">🔍 句子結構</button>':""}<div class="hint"></div><div class="exp"></div><div class="sx"></div>`;
  const ob=d.querySelector(".opts"),hb=d.querySelector(".hbtn"),hi=d.querySelector(".hint"),ex=d.querySelector(".exp");
  hi.innerHTML=gl(q.h);
  if(ST[q.n]){const sb=d.querySelector(".sbtn"),sp=d.querySelector(".sx");sp.innerHTML=sx(q.n);sb.onclick=()=>{const on=sp.classList.toggle("show");sb.textContent=on?"🔍 收起句子結構":"🔍 句子結構"}}
  hb.onclick=()=>{const on=hi.classList.toggle("show");hb.setAttribute("aria-expanded",on);hb.textContent=on?"💡 收起提示":"💡 提示"};
  q.o.forEach((x,i)=>{const b=document.createElement("div");b.className="opt";b.tabIndex=0;b.setAttribute("role","button");
   b.innerHTML="("+"ABCDEFGHIJ"[i]+") "+gl(x);
   const pick=e=>{if(e&&e.target.closest&&e.target.closest(".w"))return;if(ob.dataset.done)return;ob.dataset.done=1;
    [...ob.children].forEach((c,j)=>{c.classList.add("off");if(j===q.a)c.classList.add("ok")});
    const hit=i===q.a;if(hit)right++;else b.classList.add("bad");done++;
    ex.innerHTML="<b>"+(hit?"🎉 Sugoi！答對了！":"💦 差一點！正確答案是 ("+"ABCDEFGHIJ"[q.a]+")")+"</b>\n"+gl(q.e)+(q.v?'<span class="voc">📘 重要字詞　'+gl(q.v)+"</span>":"");
    const bl=document.getElementById("b"+q.n);if(bl){bl.textContent=q.o[q.a];bl.classList.add("fill")}
    ex.classList.add("show");upd()};
   b.onclick=pick;b.onkeydown=e=>{if(e.key==="Enter"||e.key===" "){e.preventDefault();pick()}};
   ob.appendChild(b)});
  app.appendChild(d)});
});

function mkTR(list,head){const trs=document.createElement("div");trs.innerHTML=head;
list.forEach(q=>{const d=document.createElement("section");d.className="tr";
 d.innerHTML='<div class="qh"><span class="no">'+q.n+'</span></div><p>'+q.zh+'</p><div class="en">'+q.tpl.replace(/\{(\d)\}/g,(m,i)=>'<input data-i="'+(i-1)+'" aria-label="空格'+i+'" autocomplete="off">')+'</div><button class="hbtn chk">✔ 檢查</button> <button class="hbtn hb">💡 提示</button><div class="hint"></div><div class="exp"></div>';
 const hi=d.querySelector(".hint"),ex=d.querySelector(".exp");hi.textContent=q.h;
 d.querySelector(".hb").onclick=()=>hi.classList.toggle("show");
 d.querySelector(".chk").onclick=()=>{let ok=0;d.querySelectorAll("input").forEach(x=>{const g=x.value.trim().toLowerCase()&&q.ans[x.dataset.i].includes(x.value.trim().toLowerCase());x.classList.toggle("ok",g);x.classList.toggle("bad",!g);if(g)ok++});
  ex.innerHTML="<b>"+(ok===q.ans.length?"🎉 全對！":"✏️ 答對 "+ok+" / "+q.ans.length+" 格")+"</b>\n參考答案：<i>"+q.full+"</i>\n📘 評分：每個錯誤扣 0.5 分，相同拼字錯誤只扣一次。";ex.classList.add("show")};
 trs.appendChild(d)});
app.appendChild(trs)}
mkTR(FL,"<h2>第貳部分｜混合題（Q47–50）</h2><div class=\"note\">先讀展覽介紹，再填寫答案。</div><div class=\"pass\"><p>The exhibition <i>Rapa Nui: Echoes of the Moai</i> explores the heritage of the Rapa Nui, a civilization developed on one of the most isolated islands on Earth. The Moai, their iconic stone statues, are only part of their story. The six galleries ahead take you on a journey into their enduring legacy.</p><img class=\"map\" src=\""+IMG47+"\" alt=\"展覽平面圖\">"+EX.map(x=>'<p><b>'+x[0]+'</b><br>'+gl(x[1])+'</p>').join("")+"</div>");
mkTR(TR,'<h2>第參部分｜中譯英</h2><div class="note">填入關鍵字（每格一個單字），按「檢查」。部分格子有多個可接受答案。</div>');
const r=document.createElement("button");r.className="reset";r.textContent="🌸 重新挑戰";r.onclick=()=>location.reload();app.appendChild(r);
function upd(){document.getElementById("sc").textContent="⭐ "+right+" / "+done;document.getElementById("pg").style.width=(done/total*100)+"%"}
function say(x){if(!window.speechSynthesis)return;speechSynthesis.cancel();const u=new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(x);u.lang="en-US";u.rate=.85;speechSynthesis.speak(u)}
function show(w){let k=w.dataset.k,v=G[k];if(v&&v[0]==="→"){k=v.slice(1);v=G[k]}if(!v)return;const[m,u,x]=v.split("||"),[en,zh]=(x||"").split("／");
 tip.innerHTML="<b>"+k+'</b> <button class="say" data-say="'+k+'" aria-label="發音">🔊</button><br>'+m+(u?'<div class="u">✨ '+u+"</div>":"")+(en?'<div class="ex">'+en+' <button class="say" data-say="'+en.replace(/"/g,"&quot;")+'" aria-label="例句發音">🔊</button><br><small>'+(zh||"")+"</small></div>":"");tip.style.display="block";
 const b=w.getBoundingClientRect(),W=tip.offsetWidth,H=tip.offsetHeight;
 tip.style.left=Math.max(8,Math.min(b.left,innerWidth-W-8))+"px";tip.style.top=(b.bottom+H+16>innerHeight?Math.max(8,b.top-H-10):b.bottom+8)+"px"}
document.addEventListener("click",e=>{const s=e.target.closest(".say");if(s){say(s.dataset.say);return}if(e.target.closest("#tip"))return;const w=e.target.closest(".w");w?show(w):tip.style.display="none"});
document.addEventListener("keydown",e=>{if(e.key==="Escape")tip.style.display="none";if(e.key==="Enter"&&e.target.classList.contains("w"))show(e.target)});
upd();
</script><footer><p>2026＠Maxine</p></footer></body></html>
